hanzi: 我觉得这个电影很有意思。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège diànyǐng hěn yǒu yìsi.
english: I think this movie is very interesting.

hanzi: 虽然天晴，但是天气很冷。
pinyin: Suīrán tiān qíng, dànshì tiānqì hěn lěng.
english: Although the sky is clear, the weather is very cold.

hanzi: 我去过中国三次，还想再去玩儿。
pinyin: Wǒ qùguo Zhōngguó sān cì, hái xiǎng zài qù wánr.
english: I have been to China three times and still want to go have fun again.

hanzi: 这件衣服两百块，我觉得不贵。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu liǎng bǎi kuài, wǒ juéde bú guì.
english: This piece of clothing costs two hundred yuan; I think it is not expensive.

hanzi: 她看过这个电影两次，还觉得很有意思。
pinyin: Tā kànguo zhège diànyǐng liǎng cì, hái juéde hěn yǒu yìsi.
english: She has seen this movie twice and still thinks it is very interesting.

hanzi: 虽然我去过几次，但是还想再去玩儿。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ qùguo jǐ cì, dànshì hái xiǎng zài qù wánr.
english: Although I have been a few times, I still want to go have fun again.

hanzi: 今天天气很好，我们一起出去玩儿吧。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ chūqu wánr ba.
english: The weather is very nice today; let us go out and have fun together.

hanzi: 这个星期我有时间，想和你一起去看电影。
pinyin: Zhège xīngqī wǒ yǒu shíjiān, xiǎng hé nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
english: I have time this week and want to go see a movie with you.
